method: Laplacian pyramid fusion of MRI with the SPECT luminance; SPECT chrominance carried through unchanged
warnings: This dataset carries no diagnosis labels, so the fusion stage is measured by reference-free fusion quality only. No classification accuracy is claimed for it, and the method's four-class prediction still comes from its trained MRI branch.
The pairs are supplied pre-registered. This stage fuses them; it does not register them, and a misregistered pair would fuse into a misaligned image.
15 cases only (357 slices). These numbers describe this dataset, not MRI–SPECT fusion in general.

metric_definitions.entropy: information content of the fused image (bits)
metric_definitions.std: contrast, as the standard deviation of fused intensity
metric_definitions.mutual_information_mri: information the fused image shares with the MRI
metric_definitions.mutual_information_spect: information the fused image shares with the SPECT luminance
metric_definitions.ssim_spect: structural similarity to the SPECT luminance
metric_definitions.qabf: Xydeas & Petrovic edge preservation, 0-1: how much of both sources' gradient information survived
